source: EDGAR 10-K history walk (competitor/supplier-context prose, EDGAR_10K_COMPETITION_SECTION_PROSE) -- the analogue of HYP04_EDGAR_LINKAGE_HISTORY.json for the ASC 280 path, which this walk does not cover
not_a_replacement: A review queue for a human, not a linkage map. No row here is curated, and none is promoted automatically. Every claim carries an accession number so it can be checked against the filing.
what_the_earliest_date_means: The earliest filing that NAMES the counterparty, which is the claim as_of_date makes. Not evidence the relationship began then -- only that it was publicly disclosed by then.
why_earliest_matters: Peer eligibility (peer_selection.py) counts a candidate only for anchor events at or after its as_of_date. The earliest disclosing filing maximises how many real anchor events (HYP04_ANCHOR_SHOCKS_2026-08-31.csv) a candidate can be evaluated against.
